summary: Iteration 22 PASS. All iter21 critical fixes verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed. Manual hospitality (mode='manual', no tenant_id) creates a record (200), is idempotent on (landlord_id, contract_id), supports PUT updates, and /api/hospitality/pdf/record/{id} returns valid %PDF for manual records. Tenant-mode hospitality regression intact. GET /api/properties and GET /api/properties/{id} now normalize legacy docs with civico/comune/province defaults. Regression smoke (landlords.authority, dashboard, invoices PDF, tenants list, /api/hospitality/pdf/{tenant_id}) all green. Frontend: /hospitality dialog has working Da Inquilino vs Crea Manualmente toggle (data-testid=hospitality-mode-tenant / hospitality-mode-manual). In manual mode the Inquilino/Immobile selects hide; OSPITATO (MANUALE) guest fields appear; Proprietario + Contratto remain. Switching back restores tenant flow. No regressions on Properties (Via/Civico/Comune/Provincia separate fields), Preavviso menu/route, owners authority, OCR sticky banner, or PDF downloads.

BACKEND_HOSPITALITY_MANUAL_POST.evidence: POST /api/hospitality/records with mode='manual', landlord_id+contract_id, guest_* fields and no tenant_id/property_id/check_in_date returns 200 and persists record with mode='manual'.

BACKEND_HOSPITALITY_MANUAL_IDEMPOTENT.evidence: Second POST with same (landlord_id, contract_id) returns same id (upsert; no duplicate).

BACKEND_HOSPITALITY_MANUAL_PUT.evidence: PUT /api/hospitality/records/{id} updates manual record; new guest_passport persists in subsequent GET /records list.

BACKEND_HOSPITALITY_PDF_RECORD.evidence: GET /api/hospitality/pdf/record/{id} returns Content starting with %PDF for manual records.

BACKEND_PROPERTIES_NORMALIZATION.evidence: Every property in GET /api/properties has civico/comune/province keys (defaulted to ''/'PD'). GET /api/properties/{id} also normalized.

FRONTEND_MODE_TOGGLE.evidence: Mode buttons present (data-testid=hospitality-mode-tenant, hospitality-mode-manual). Switching to manual hides hospitality-tenant-select and reveals hospitality-guest-surname; Proprietario+Contratto selects remain. Switching back restores tenant select.

FRONTEND_REGRESSION.evidence: Properties form retains Via/Civico/Comune/Provincia fields; Preavviso menu present; OCR sticky banner visible inside dialog; PDF buttons render.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (console warning) — accessibility minor, same warning seen in iter21.

action_items: LOW: add aria-describedby (or DialogDescription) on Hospitality DialogContent to silence Radix accessibility warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/hospitality.py: branched upsert key on (landlord_id, contract_id) for manual and tenant_id for tenant mode is correct and idempotent. Good defensive checks for landlord/contract existence.
routes/properties.py setdefault('province','PD') hard-codes Padova as default. Acceptable for this app (Padova-based) but consider empty string for purity if multi-region in future.
Hospitality.js: mode toggle via simple button group is clean; conditional rendering correct. Submit button label switches between create/update properly.
Frontend handleDownloadPdfByRecord uses /pdf/record/{id} for manual records — confirmed by code path; backend endpoint returns valid PDF.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (mode toggle, conditional rendering, regressions all PASS)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_IT22 manual hospitality record. No persistent test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 fully validates the iteration 21 HIGH bug fix (manual hospitality + properties normalization). All previous regression coverage retained. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration22.py is the new regression suite — run it before any future hospitality/properties change.
rca of the issue: Iter21's failed feature was (1) HospitalityCreate schema rejecting payloads without tenant_id (422) and (2) frontend missing mode toggle. Main agent fix made tenant_id/property_id/check_in_date Optional, added mode field, _is_manual helper, branched upsert key on (landlord_id, contract_id) for manual mode, added /pdf/record/{id} endpoint that handles both modes, and updated GET /records to synthesize tenant_name from guest_* in manual mode. Frontend added hospitality-mode-tenant / hospitality-mode-manual toggle with conditional rendering. Properties GET endpoints now setdefault civico/comune/province for legacy doc normalization. All verified by 13 passing pytest cases plus a Playwright UI smoke.
